# Shaerware Digital

> Founder: **Шер Артём Юрьевич / Artem Y. Sher**. Custom AI development studio specializing in business-grade AI assistants on Laravel + local LLMs (vLLM, Open WebUI). Average client savings: 300,000–500,000 ₽ / $5K–15K per month by automating routine operations.

## What we do

- **AI assistants** for customer support, sales, and internal workflows — runs 24/7, replaces 3–5 employees
- **SaaS platforms** with subscription models on Laravel
- **Enterprise integrations** — connect AI to CRM, ERP, helpdesk, custom databases
- **Local LLM deployment** — vLLM, Open WebUI, fine-tuning, on-prem inference
- **Free AI audit** — 30-min call → identify automation opportunities → ROI estimate in rubles/dollars

## Stack

- Backend: PHP / Laravel, Node.js, Java
- AI: vLLM, Open WebUI, local LLMs, OpenAI / Anthropic APIs
- Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis
- Infra: Docker, nginx, Ubuntu, VPS / on-prem
- Frontend: JavaScript, React, Vue.js
